paragraphs.text: Intelligence That Stays Current With the Work
Continuous Intelligence supports the operating cycle by keeping permitted context and analysis current as relevant signals, connected systems, workflows, events, and outcomes change.
• Sense - Capture permitted signals and material change.
• Understand - Reassess what the change means in context.
• Recommend - Bring forward relevant options, implications, and uncertainty.
• Act - Progress only within the authority already granted; pause where approval is required.
This intelligence loop supports Clarity -> Capability -> Consistency. It does not replace the user-facing operating model, and it does not create new authority.
